Health Care Roundup: Market Talk

The latest Market Talks covering the Health Care sector. Published exclusively on Dow Jones Newswires at 4:20 ET, 12:20 ET and 16:50 ET.

0817 ET – Loblaw’s pharmacy unit, Shoppers Drug Mart, shines in 3Q as prescription demand easily outpaced grocery growth. The Canadian grocer’s total drug retail sales rose 5.7% in the quarter to C$5.81 billion, more than double the 2.8% growth rate of its grocery business. Same-store sales growth was 4.8%, benefiting from specialty and chronic prescriptions. Loblaw notes that on a same-store basis, the number of prescriptions it dispensed in the quarter increased by 3.9%, with average prescription value up 4.3%. For its front store, beauty and over-the-counter products were the biggest drivers. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
